title: Docling import sources v1
description: Which source document each Markdown file in a `data import docling` output directory was converted from (docs/ingestion-docling.md), kept there as `.dokimi-docling.json`. A rerun replaces the file the record gives a source; another source with the same name gets the next numbered file.

run_id.description: The envelope: the id of the run that saved this file (dokimi.artifacts.run_id). Absent from files saved before the envelope.

dokimi_version.description: The envelope: the dokimi version that saved this file. Absent from files saved before the envelope.

name.description: The Markdown file's name in the output directory: a name, not a path (a `\` is a name character on POSIX; on Windows a name holding one is not used).

source.description: The source document it was converted from, `/`-separated: relative to the output directory, or absolute when there is none (another Windows drive).

files.description: One entry per file, sorted by name.
